blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30. The Sourcify exact-match LatamStable implementation 0x8898786f1e1e9ed77def940a2ecb7cf07af8d6ba (source re-opened 2026-07-30) inherits ERC20PausableUpgradeable with _update gated whenNotPaused, so a live PAUSER_ROLE can halt every holder transfer globally; it exposes no per-address blacklist, freeze, or seize mapping. All six deployments share this implementation: the Ethereum and Base proxy EIP-1967 implementation slots re-read at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608 both resolve to it, and the 2026-07-20 deployment-scoped transfer review verified code-hash identity on worldchain, bsc, polygon, and gnosis. Role history from RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs on Ethereum: deployer 0x5ca3f8eeba12d83408fc097c2dad79212456f20f held all roles from initialization (block 23891029) and was fully revoked at block 24995207, when DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, and UPGRADER all moved to Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b. Fixed-block reads confirm hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, that EOA) = true and paused() = false at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608; UPGRADER_ROLE (UUPS, no timelock) is held by the same EOA, with the 4-of-7 Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 as second DEFAULT_ADMIN. Reach is a token-level global pause controlled by a single EOA, not a per-address blacklist, and transfers are currently open; true reflects that live pause capability (same verdict basis as the dusd-dtrinity 2026-07-30 review). No wrapper or bridge inheritance applies - issuance is issuer-native burn-mint on every chain.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WCLP has six independent native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis; their native MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and UUPS upgrade paths remain in Mint Authority. Celo is a reviewed issuer-operated burn/mint representation: the live token role graph, registered LimitedMinterBridge, BridgeDeposit linkage, operator roles, enabled outbound peers, replay guard, rate limits, pause controls, and fixed-destination minter are now identified from verified source and current Celo state.

Ripio's Celo launch announcement publishes this WCLP deployment. At Celo block 75967600, the token granted MINTER_ROLE to LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167c... and fixed-destination LimitedMinter 0xd168cf..., while the 4-of-7 Ripio Safe retained the token's admin, minter, pauser, and upgrader roles. LimitedMinterBridge registered WCLP with a 4,750,000-token daily cap and granted mint access to BridgeDeposit 0x465e64... and an operator EOA. BridgeDeposit pointed back to that adapter, exposed a two-member operator set, and enabled WCLP routes to all six reviewed source chains. This is a reviewed issuer-operated burn/mint representation; privileged administrators can bypass or change its accounting controls, which is priced in the route tier rather than hidden as an identity gap.
HyperEVMScan records successful creation and a verified ERC-20 wCLP at this address; available evidence does not establish mint authority, source chain, or bridge semantics.

controls.label: Ripio WCLP Celo BridgeDeposit burn and fulfillment
controls.capDescription: BridgeDeposit is the issuer-operated source-burn and destination-fulfillment controller. Its administrators can change enabled peers, fees, the LimitedMinterBridge pointer, operator membership, and pause state.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Celo block 75967600, BridgeDeposit pointed to LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167c..., held the adapter's MINTER_ROLE, and enabled WCLP outbound routes to Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Two BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE holders can submit destination fulfillments.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: depositForBridge() burns source WCLP and records totalBurnedTo; fulfillBridgeMint() records totalMintedFrom and bridgeFulfilled keyed by source chain, transaction hash, and deposit ID. The six current Celo peer counters were zero at the observation block.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: BridgeDeposit had two DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders (EOA 0x5ca3f8ee... and Safe 0x2b839174...), two bridge operators, one fee manager, and paused()=false. Administrators can reconfigure peers, operators, fees, pause state, and the adapter pointer.

controls.evidence: The verified Celo BridgeDeposit is the live WCLP bridge caller: it points to LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167c..., appears in that adapter's MINTER_ROLE, has two operator principals, and enables all six source/destination chain IDs authored by WCLP. Its source enforces a burn on deposit, operator-gated destination fulfillment, replay protection, and per-peer accounting, while its two administrators can reconfigure those controls.
